_comment: Declarative routing table for the shared `tsp-spector verify-surface-checks` engine. AUTHORED once per emitter — NOT generated. The engine substitutes placeholders into `find`/`scope`: {target}=the subject name (from @surfaceDoc), {expected}=the expected client-surface output. Add `:casing` to recase, e.g. {expected:snake}, {target:pascal}. Use `:byKind` to apply per-kind casing from the `casing` map (keyed by `details.kind`). `expect`: present (default), absent, {absentWhen:<detailKey>}, or {whenExpected:{<value>:present|absent}}. SCOPE: when a check is scoped to a language, the engine only runs it for the matching language and matches {expected} VERBATIM (casing modifiers are ignored).
